mcp-atlassian.description: Jira + Confluence access (sooperset/mcp-atlassian, run via uvx) for ticket ingestion and doc/handoff publishing. JIRA_URL, JIRA_PROJECTS_FILTER, CONFLUENCE_URL, CONFLUENCE_SPACES_FILTER, and READ_ONLY_MODE are hardcoded Vincit-wide constants (same site/project/space for every engagement using this plugin) — not secrets, safe to commit. Only the two usernames still come from /vinsap:config → .sdlc/config.json. API tokens are NEVER stored in config or committed files — set JIRA_API_TOKEN and CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN as real environment variables in your own shell/profile; the ${VAR} placeholders below are resolved from your environment at launch, not from this file.
